cases.question: What organelle is the powerhouse of the cell?

documents.title: Cell biology
documents.text: The mitochondria is the powerhouse of the cell. It generates most of the cell's supply of adenosine triphosphate (ATP).

cases.question: In which city is the Eiffel Tower located?

documents.title: Landmarks
documents.text: The Eiffel Tower is located in Paris, France. It was completed in 1889.

cases.question: Who created the Python programming language?

documents.title: Languages
documents.text: Python was created by Guido van Rossum and first released in 1991.

cases.question: What is the capital of Thailand?

documents.title: Geography
documents.text: Bangkok is the capital and most populous city of Thailand.

cases.question: What is the approximate speed of light?

documents.title: Physics
documents.text: The speed of light in vacuum is exactly 299792458 meters per second.
